importNote: Combined St. Anne's/Fall River Philips Ingenia 1.5T additions: Seizure brain + MS brain add-ons (3), Orbits (5), IAC (5), Pituitary (5), Fast brain (5) = 23 new protocols, 6 exam sets. Every protocol id is unique and appears once. examSets and importNote are not existing backup keys; the app ignores them unless Claude Code adds support. Brain 'Cor T1 3mm' (Seizure) and IAC 'COR T1 3mm' are different protocols with names that differ only by case; match exam members by protocolIds, or by name + region.
